evidence: Cobaltocene (CoCp2) and trimethyl phosphate (TMP) were selected as precursors for the process. Argon gas (>99.999% purity) was used to carry CoCp2 vapor from the container to the reactor through a line heated to 100 °C. TMP was vapor drawn to the chamber, heating its container to 50 °C and the line to the reactor to 70 °C.
